title: Identify and Locate the 'codespace' Heading Element
description: Find the React component and file where the primary 'codespace' heading is rendered to determine which Tailwind CSS classes control its font size.
details: Search within 'app/page.tsx' and 'app/dashboard/page.tsx' for the heading displaying 'codespace'. If not found directly, check for imported components (e.g., Title, Header) or within 'components/ui/'. Inspect the JSX to confirm the current Tailwind font size class (e.g., 'text-5xl').
test_strategy: Confirm the heading is correctly identified by matching the displayed text and inspecting the rendered DOM in the browser. Ensure the correct file/component is targeted for modification.

title: Modify Tailwind CSS Font Size Class for the Heading
description: Reduce the font size of the 'codespace' heading by updating the relevant Tailwind CSS class to a smaller value, maintaining semantic HTML and accessibility.
details: Change the font size utility class (e.g., from 'text-5xl' to 'text-4xl' or smaller as appropriate) on the identified heading element. Ensure the element remains a semantic heading tag (e.g., <h1>). If the heading is rendered via a reusable component, update the prop or class accordingly. Adhere to the project's typographic scale as defined in 'tailwind.config.ts'.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the heading in the browser to confirm the font size is reduced. Use browser dev tools to verify the applied class and semantic tag. Check for accessibility compliance (screen reader, heading structure).

title: Verify Responsive and Themed Appearance of the Updated Heading
description: Ensure the resized heading displays correctly across all supported screen sizes and in both light and dark modes.
details: Preview the updated heading on mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports using browser dev tools or responsive design mode. Toggle dark mode to confirm the heading remains legible and visually balanced in both themes. Adjust adjacent spacing or layout if the new size disrupts visual hierarchy.
test_strategy: Manually test the heading's appearance on multiple viewport sizes and in both light and dark modes. Confirm no layout or readability issues are introduced. Optionally, capture before/after screenshots for stakeholder review.

title: Cross-Browser and Visual Regression Validation
description: Check the updated heading's appearance in major browsers and ensure no unintended visual regressions have occurred.
details: Open the application in Chrome, Firefox, and Safari to confirm consistent rendering of the resized heading. Compare the updated UI to previous screenshots or design references to ensure only the intended change is present. If available, use a preview deployment (e.g., Vercel) for stakeholder review before merging.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the heading in each browser. Use screenshot comparison tools if available. Solicit feedback from stakeholders via preview deployment.
